data.representation: equalized=1; center crop/pad 256; per-packet complex RMS; center=False; fs=25MHz

roles.U_use: IQ/RX/day/opaque ID only, no TX truth; diagnostic objective only, no optimizer

data.split_id: inherited deterministic physical source roles (historical protocol label 392005)
data.train_ratio_definition: rho_label=L_s/(L_s+U_s)=0.1 unchanged; U_s TX truth never visible
data.diagnostic_access: Full L6300/V27000 eval/no_grad paired readouts; 24 independent L-only reference gradient rounds with hidden-TX U128. V never backward. No target loader.

code.commit: resolved from immutable Git release at launch

execution.stop_rule: technical failure stops pending; healthy finish; no automatic retry/overwrite

permissions.claim_scope: known-source error correction and gradient compatibility only; all five source RX were seen by parent; not unknown-RX or training-benefit proof

display_name: E20浅中层机制：固定源样本纠错与同权重梯度方向诊断
description: 三种子全部L/V配对错误迁移及L-only梯度；八个固定终点；0身份更新、无目标访问
authorization: 持续84%目标及三个机制问题的源域研究；浅中层Fishr/MixStyle；仅L辅助头预热200步，身份更新0；V只no_grad、U不读TX真值、无目标访问

checkpoint.initialization: strict corresponding original native E20; fresh shallow/middle heads warmed200 L-only steps
checkpoint.endpoint_sources: all eight fixed final20 rows per seed of 20261012-phase1-e20-budget-fishr-manysig-m24-r01
checkpoint.selection_rule: all eight fixed arms; no source/target subset selection
checkpoint.source_check: cvs_e20_foundation.verify + cvs_e20_budget_fishr.evaluate source metadata + strict checkpoint loader
checkpoint.inheritance: scratch native E20; endpoints E20+20; fresh diagnostic heads no old auxiliary weights

metric_names: per-layer task vs independent L CE gradient cosine/dot/norm ratio
metrics_plan.scorer_ref: paired_readout source L/V; target scorer not used
metrics_plan.pairs: parent E20 to all eight fixed endpoints; same-weight objectives to independent L CE

independent_review.scope: source roles/no V backward; fixed E20/all8 checkpoint lineage; gradient direction/RNG preservation; dispatch capacity/output ownership

notes: Source-only diagnostic, no identity candidate produced, no target test scheduled.
All source RX seen by parent; V is not unseen-RX.
3x9x33300=899100 source readouts;3x24x8=576 gradient records;600 head-only warmup steps.
No target scores/predictions/error lists consumed; previous source execution motivated diagnostic.
All endpoints fixed; no ranking/subset or checkpoint choice from readouts.

rows.purpose: 三种子全部L/V配对错误迁移及L-only梯度；八个固定终点；0身份更新、无目标访问

risk_recipe.auxiliary_batch_scope: at most32 fresh source-L packets; R may separately re-encode at most32 cached audit IQ packets; count both
risk_recipe.source_selection: fixed final epoch; all three rows tested
risk_recipe.reference: periodically frozen own student; no EMA teacher
risk_recipe.action_scope: bounded post-receive linear/phase increments; no satellite simulator in training
risk_recipe.source_u_scope: No U access in any arm

source_stress.ranking: clean feasibility then stress mean+worst RX risk; descriptive source-only ranking across three seeds; within .2pp prefer fewer auxiliary parameters
source_stress.selection: three-seed source V only; clean feasibility .5pp then mean+worstRX performance; exact ties lower ratio

feature_recipe.calibration_scope: mature source-L relation buckets; fixed once, no later weight adaptation
feature_recipe.style_scope: native labeled clean CE only; no extra CE or KL
feature_recipe.statistical_ema: gradient statistics only, not an EMA teacher

source_selection.rule: fixed final epoch; every predeclared row tested; no source V epoch selection
source_selection.future_compression: USER EXPLICIT EXCEPTION: clean three-seed mean no more than 0.003 below fixed original E200 permits shorter epoch exploration
source_selection.benchmark_role: exposed development benchmark for epoch budget only; not independent blind test

reference_E200.role: comparison only; never loaded for initialization

optimizer.name: AdamW
optimizer.schedule: reset AdamW; epoch cosine20; same LR for all identity parameters; parent20 + incremental20 = total40

semi.target_provider: live detached eval-mode student; no copy or EMA

multilevel.sampling: L only same-day 6TX x 5RX x2; U groups are detached weak predictions, both>=.95, cross RX same day
multilevel.fishr_scope: actual readout weight+bias sample gradients; head values stopped in Fishr; backbone-only regularization
multilevel.gradient_budget_scope: time_fuse for shallow, t2 for middle; per-term before mean; aggregate achieved norms logged

rx_action.L_fit: other five TX AND other two days
rx_action.U_fit: all six L TX, other two days; U TX never read
rx_action.critic_fit: actual deterministic CE increment on up to32L, identity detached; smoothL1; zero-action anchored
rx_action.action_selection: eight candidates: four other sourceRX times two fixed scales; no identity class prediction in bank lookup

parent_build_config.sampling: same seed-private RX/day-balanced full permutation for L and independently U; no TX grouping/hidden U labels
parent_build_config.feature_target: none; multilevel source gradient variance and optional U main-path style

config.endpoint_selection: all eight fixed rows, no target- or V-based subset
config.gradient_scope: same original E20+L-warmed heads; all8 objectives, independent next-day L reference; actual train dropout; no optimizer or identity update
config.evaluation_scope: all L and V fixed-PID parent/end readouts; V eval/no_grad only; no U truth or target access
config.claim_scope: known-source error correction and gradient compatibility only; all five source RX were seen by parent; not unknown-RX or training-benefit proof
config.output_policy: exclusive new source audit directory; save source probabilities and summaries, no IQ or deployable checkpoint
